narrative: Sarah H contributed to TrueSight DAO and Cypher Defense projects from October 2020 to May 2024, with contributions primarily in the Build Game across strategy, marketing, user experience, and community management categories. She participated in five online poll votes, reshared two short media posts on social platforms, attended a FaceTime meeting, wrote and posted one official DAO social media text post, validated a user behavior, helped with a single community management task for a day, provided reference material with a strategy extension idea, and contributed a full-scale strategy with rollout action plan to grow the DAO.
